title: The content rules and the lint accept a validity window on a fact line and a commit range on a CODE fact
goal: content-rules.md defines how a fact states when it became true and when it stopped, as the marker before its tag that the operator's gate names: (valid YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD) for DOC and DER facts and (valid REV..REV) with short commit ids for CODE facts, an open end written as nothing after the two dots; the contract lint accepts a well-formed window and rejects a malformed one, an end before a start or a commit range on a fact whose cited source is not pinned; rag.py audit counts each article's facts whose window has ended; a fact with no window is valid from its retrieval date with no end, so every existing fact stays valid unchanged.

run:
import csv,os,re,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
d=tempfile.mkdtemp();n=chr(10)
def w(p,t):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.join(d,p)) or d,exist_ok=True);open(os.path.join(d,p),'w').write(t)
w('_root.md','---'+n+'root: zzplant'+n+'id_prefix: ZQ'+n+'visibility: internal'+n+'description: planted'+n+'---'+n+n+'# zzplant'+n)
H='id,url,title,publisher,licence,reuse,retrieved_utc,version_or_date,artifact_sha256,used_in,superseded_by'
R=['ZQ-aaaabbbb,https://learn.microsoft.com/x,X,Microsoft,,link,2025-01-10,2025-01-01,,t/a.md,',
   'ZQ-ccccdddd,https://github.com/o/r/blob/0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567/m.py,M,O,MIT,link,2025-01-10,v1,,t/a.md,',
   'ZQ-eeeeffff,https://github.com/o/r/blob/main/m.py,M2,O,MIT,link,2025-01-10,main,,t/a.md,']
w('_sources.csv',H+n+n.join(R)+n)
e=dict(os.environ,KB_ROOTS=d)
def run(*a):
    p=s.run([sys.executable,*a],env=e,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=900);print(' '.join(a)[:80],'->',p.returncode,p.stdout[-600:],p.stderr[-300:]);return p
def art(facts):
    w('t/a.md','---'+n+'topic: t/a'+n+'sources: ZQ-aaaabbbb ZQ-ccccdddd ZQ-eeeeffff'+n+'---'+n+n+'# A'+n+n+'## Summary'+n+n+'S.'+n+n+'## Facts'+n+n+n.join(facts)+n+n+'## Reference'+n+n+'R. [DOC ZQ-aaaabbbb] [CODE ZQ-ccccdddd m.py#f] [DOC ZQ-eeeeffff]'+n+n+'## Examples'+n+n+'E.'+n)
    run('_tools/build_index.py')
def lint():
    import json
    p=run('.claude/skills/kb-verify/lint.py','zzplant/t/a.md','--json')
    try:
        return json.loads(p.stdout or '[]')
    except ValueError:
        return [{'level':'ERROR','path':'?','message':'lint printed no JSON: '+p.stdout[-200:]}]
art(['- Ended fact. (valid 2020-01-01..2021-12-31) [DOC ZQ-aaaabbbb]','- Current fact. (valid 2022-01-01..) [DOC ZQ-aaaabbbb]','- Plain fact, no window. [DOC ZQ-aaaabbbb]'])
p=run('_tools/rag.py','audit','zzplant/t/a')
L=[l for l in p.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('|')]
h=[c.strip() for c in L[0].strip('|').split('|')] if L else []
k=[i for i,c in enumerate(h) if re.search('ended|expired|no longer|window|valid',c,re.I)]
r=[[c.strip() for c in l.strip('|').split('|')] for l in L if 'zzplant/t/a' in l]
v=r[0][k[0]] if k and r else None
print('column',[h[i] for i in k],'value',v);sys.exit(0 if v=='1' else 1)

import re,sys;t=open('kb/_self/content-rules.md').read();sys.exit(0 if re.search(r'\(valid \d{4}-\d\d-\d\d\.\.',t) and re.search(r'CODE[^\n]*\(valid [0-9a-f]{7,}\.\.|\(valid [0-9a-f]{7,}\.\.[^\n]*CODE',t) else 1)

gates.question: How does a fact line carry its validity window?
options: a marker before the tag, such as (valid 2024-03-01..2025-09-30)
fields inside the tag, such as [DOC S12 valid=2024-03-01..2025-09-30]
a sidecar csv keyed by the fact's anchor, the line itself unchanged
gates.recommendation: a marker before the tag, such as (valid 2024-03-01..2025-09-30)
gates.reason: every tag parser stays as it is and a reader sees the window on the line
gates.answer: a marker before the tag, such as (valid 2024-03-01..2025-09-30)
